title: Regional Price Index: Multi-Channel Digital Subscr
subtitle: App Store vs Google Play vs web vs Steam prices, landed USD, PPP
description:
Local list prices of 25 digital subscriptions, games and devices (37 plan tiers) across 18 storefronts and four checkout channels (iOS App Store, Google Play, direct web, Steam), with FX-converted USD, tax- and gift-card-adjusted landed cost, IMF PPP and work-hour affordability, payment friction and a four-tier verification flag. Every row was observed on an official storefront or vendor page within 30 days of the snapshot; storefronts not yet observed are omitted, never estimated. Snapshot 2026.11.01.

Methodology: https://regionalpriceindex.com/methodology/

resources.description: One row per product × plan × storefront × channel × billing cycle

fields.name: plan_id
fields.description: Plan tier identifier, e.g. plus, pro, 2tb

fields.name: category
fields.description: ai | streaming | productivity | cloud | steam | apple

fields.name: local_price
fields.description: List price in the billing currency

fields.name: fx_rate
fields.description: Units of currency per USD at snapshot

fields.name: landed_usd
fields.description: spot_usd × (1 + observed reseller premium) on gift-card routes with an observed listing; otherwise spot_usd. No tax added

fields.name: savings_vs_us
fields.description: 1 − landed_usd / lowest US list price (same plan and cycle)

fields.name: work_hours
fields.description: Hours of GNI per capita per month of use (or per purchase): spot / (GNI per capita / 2000)

fields.name: ppp_intl_usd
fields.description: Local price per month of use (or per purchase) ÷ IMF implied PPP conversion rate

fields.name: payment_route
fields.description: gift_card (official gift cards; Steam: resold wallet codes) | store_payment (no gift cards) | web_checkout (vendor checkout)

fields.name: is_best_channel
fields.description: Cheapest landed channel for this plan in this storefront
